headlines.title: Trump Promises $5,000 to Voters if Republicans Win Midterms
headlines.description: President Donald Trump took centerstage at the GOP’s first ever midterm convention, urging voters to think of him when they cast their ballots in November. The president also announced that if Republicans hold both the House and Senate after the elections, he’ll push for every U.S. citizen to receive a $5,000 “dividend.” NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Helena Foulkes wins Rhode Island Democratic governor primary, NBC News projects
headlines.description: Rhode Island Gov. Dan McKee has lost his Democratic primary to former CVS executive Helena Foulkes, NBC News projects, after facing a significant spending disadvantage and voter discontent with his tenure. NBC News' Steve Kornacki breaks down the numbers.

headlines.title: Hurricane carves path of destruction in Hawaii
headlines.description: More than 80% of customers are without power on the island of Kauai after Hurricane Lowell left a path of destruction. NBC News’ Liz Kreutz is in the storm zone tonight.

headlines.title: Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs Candy Recalled Over Allergy Risks
headlines.description: New Jersey candy company Little Temptations has recalled their popular “chocolatey eyeballs” because of undeclared milk allergens. The candy is sold at major retailers including Marshalls, TJ Maxx, and Home Goods in 13 states.

headlines.title: Skeletal remains found in North Carolina nearly 50 years ago identified as 15-year-old runaway girl
headlines.description: Human remains found nearly a half-century ago in North Carolina were identified as having come from a 15-year-old Maryland girl who ran away from home months earlier, state law enforcement officials said Tuesday.

headlines.title: U.S. crude oil hits $100 for the first time since May
headlines.description: The price of oil surged again, with Brent crude surpassing $105 per barrel for the first time since May as markets brace for a long U.S. war with Iran.

headlines.title: Apple just launched a folding iPhone — here’s what you need to know
headlines.description: Apple just unveiled its first folding iPhone alongside five other major product launches. Here’s everything you need to know about what’s new.

headlines.title: How to treat and prevent ingrown hair without popping, picking or plucking
headlines.description: How to get rid of ingrown hairs with products from Topicals, Fur, Mario Badescu and more. Here's why dermatologists say you shouldn't pop razor bumps.

headlines.title: Does your dog really need its own bed?
headlines.description: Experts weigh in on the best dog beds to keep your pet well rested. Shop Casper, Big Barker, L.L.Bean, Orvis and more based on comfort, size and quality.

headlines.title: This popular Lenovo monitor is more than $130 off
headlines.description: The Lenovo L32p-30 31.5-inch 4K monitor is 29% off during Lenovo’s Labor Day sale. Shop the deal before the sale ends Sept. 13.

headlines.title: Kevin Reddington: Lindsay Clancy wants her babies
headlines.description: In his sit-down interview with NBC News’ Laura Jarrett, Kevin Reddington, the defense attorney for Lindsay Clancy, says the woman who's living amongst us is the person that everybody loved and “the person that committed this atrocious act was as a result of postpartum psychosis combined with the medications that she was provided.”

headlines.title: Former lawyer who pulled gun on ex-wife in Ohio restaurant is convicted of attempted murder
headlines.description: Prosecutors said Matthew Exton tried to carry out the “public execution” of his ex-wife.
